headline: Difficulty diagnostics now explain why simulated levels fail

changes.title: Track exact objective progress and hazard costs for simulated attempts
changes.detail: The simulation now records unfinished targets, goal-progress stalls, real fuse expiries, wallet move debits and earned refunds, distinguishing true daily-move exhaustion from early engine termination without changing gameplay.

changes.title: Test a wider range of difficult stages and board seeds
changes.detail: A separate diagnostic tier repeats objective-aware play at every tenth level using three independent seeds, both without boosters and with at most one emergency Hammer. The original 2,000 greedy trials and 200 earlier paired trials remain intact.

changes.title: Aggregate and verify specific loss causes without weakening release checks
changes.detail: The optional report now identifies dominant unfinished objectives, lost moves to expired fuses and stalled progress by chapter, with strict daily-wallet arithmetic and paired-seed tests. These statistics are not claims of level impossibility.
